headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Required unless your MCP client uses OAuth: your ZillAPI API key, sent as 'Bearer zk_...'. Get one free at https://zillapi.com/signup/, or manage keys at https://zillapi.com/app/keys/. OAuth 2.1 is supported; MCP clients that support it discover it from https://api.zillapi.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.
